note: Rustic park off US-60 near Fordland and Rogersville, 25 minutes from Springfield. Mostly long-stay: Firefly sells 12 of the 29 sites by the night, and only one or two of those were open on each of three weeknights checked (Nov 2026-Apr 2027). A 2024 review says there is no shower house or restroom. --Claude
summary: Operator site + Firefly: $48.50/night full-hookup 30/50A pull-through (3 weeknights), $3.50 booking fee, 29 sites, open year-round, monthly $475-550 with background check. Long-stay in practice: 10-11 of the 12 Firefly units occupied on every night searched. Google 4.7/34. Five tests reported in flags; borderline on test 4.
flags: LONG-STAY five tests (operator markets daily/weekly/monthly; 'Many of our guests stay for several months or even longer'): (1) price PASS - $48.50/night on Firefly, no gateway needed; (2) nights for sale PASS - Firefly sells one night with no approval (the background check and 10-year RV rule apply only to 30+ day stays); (3) no minimum PASS; (4) nightly share BORDERLINE - Firefly lists 12 of the 29 sites (41%), but on Tue 2026-11-17, Tue 2026-12-08 and Tue 2027-04-13 it showed 11, 10 and 11 of those 12 OCCUPIED, leaving only '50/30 AMP PULL THROUGH 100X20' sites 7 and/or 8 open (2 of 29 = 7%); April 2027 being as full as November suggests the occupied units are long-term holds; (5) RV park, not a home community PASS (no homes or lots sold). My read: mostly long-stay in practice, not iffy otherwise (Google 4.7/34, reviews 2024-25 mostly overnighters: 'Easy book online & pull in for overnight stay', 'There are a few permanent camper. But all kept nice & clean'). Drop candidate only if test 4 is read by the occupancy check, as p3-313 did; keep if read by the 12 units Firefly lists.
PRICE GATE: $48.50/night (2 adults), under US$50; $3.50 per-reservation fee not counted. Google Maps 4.7 over 34 reviews; RV Life 4* $$ (stored).
Facilities: a Google review (Kathy M, June 2024, on the operator's homepage) says 'There's no shower house or bathroom' - the operator's pages do not say either way, so facilities were left unset.
